"import csv
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Inches

# Read CSV data
with open('perf_03.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    header = next(reader)
    rows = [row for row in reader]

N = len(rows)

# Parse numeric values
configs = [r[0] for r in rows]
cl_max = [float(r[1]) for r in rows]
cd_cruise = [float(r[2]) for r in rows]
ld_ratio = [float(r[3]) for r in rows]

# Compute stats
cl_max_max = max(cl_max)
cd_cruise_mean = sum(cd_cruise) / len(cd_cruise)
ld_mean = sum(ld_ratio) / len(ld_ratio)

# Find best config (max L/D)
best_idx = ld_ratio.index(max(ld_ratio))
best_config = configs[best_idx]

# Format rounded display values (per spec)
cl_max_max_str = f"{cl_max_max:.3f}"
cd_cruise_mean_str = f"{cd_cruise_mean:.4f}"
ld_mean_str = f"{ld_mean:.1f}"

# Determine rounding for each source value
def format_value(val_str):
    # Use source rounding: keep as it appears
    return val_str

# Create document
doc = Document()

# Title
title = doc.add_heading('Engineering Test Report — Aerodynamic Performance', level=0)

# Overview
doc.add_heading('Overview', level=1)
doc.add_paragraph(
    f"This report summarizes aerodynamic performance data from {N} test records."
)

# Results table
doc.add_heading('Results table', level=1)
table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=4)
table.style = 'Table Grid'
hdr = table.rows[0].cells
hdr[0].text = 'config'
hdr[1].text = 'cl_max'
hdr[2].text = 'cd_cruise'
hdr[3].text = 'ld_ratio'

for r in rows:
    cells = table.add_row().cells
    cells[0].text = r[0]
    cells[1].text = r[1]
    cells[2].text = r[2]
    cells[3].text = r[3]

# Summary
doc.add_heading('Summary', level=1)
doc.add_paragraph(
    f"Across {N} records: CLmax max = {cl_max_max_str}, "
    f"CDcruise mean = {cd_cruise_mean_str}, "
    f"L/D mean = {ld_mean_str}. "
    f"The best config (max L/D) is {best_config}."
)

# Conclusion
doc.add_heading('Conclusion', level=1)
doc.add_paragraph(
    f"Config {best_config} delivers the highest lift-to-drag ratio at "
    f"{ld_ratio[best_idx]}, making it the preferred configuration among the "
    f"tested set based on the recorded aerodynamic metrics."
)

doc.save('report.docx')"
